description: Read authoritative ApexGantt documentation from the bundled apexgantt-skill knowledge base. Call with no arguments to list all available files. Call with `file` to return that file as markdown. Use this to look up task data format, dependency types, view modes, the update lifecycle, or framework integration.

file.description: Filename to read (e.g. "SKILL.md", "data-format.md"). Omit to list available files.

name: apexgantt_get_reference
title: Get ApexGantt reference doc
